purpose: Single prospective bounded Windows Native real-document qualification (design only; GPU execution NOT authorized by this file)

selection_rule.rule: Among the 43 MPDocBench documents with exactly 5 pages (mission cap), require text_block>=20 AND table>=2 AND equation_isolated>=3 AND title>=3 per GT annotations. Exactly two documents qualify; select the one with the denser stress mix (higher formula+table+figure total). Deterministic, content-justified, no manual browsing.
selection_rule.anti_cherry_pick_justification: The selected document is the HARDEST qualifying case (handwritten Chinese with 98 isolated formulas, 3 tables, 96 text blocks, 31 titles, 8 figures across 5 pages), not an easy one; the rule was fixed before hashing identities.

usefulness.formulas: 98 isolated equations (max formula density among 5-page docs; CDM-relevant structure without requiring the scorer for the inference pilot)
usefulness.page_structure: titles/headers/footers/captions present (31 titles, captions, page furniture)
usefulness.tricky_formatting: handwriting + dense formula layout is the documented stress surface
usefulness.cross_platform_diagnostic: the same document is one of the four frozen P2-A/P2B documents with retained Linux evidence (PR #32 eval/results), enabling future Windows-vs-Linux comparison under identical policy

frozen_identities.note: Full page SHA-256 values are held in the private admission receipt at execution time; prefixes here bind the same bytes without publishing full digests of dataset content
frozen_identities.no_private_content_published: document images/GT text are not included in any ledger file
